limits_and_correspondence: Historical complete integration pins remain immutable; classified inherited failures do not become green product gates.
Final combined source is reconciled, its complete PR/integration trees match and postintegration main CI passes.
No physical, entropy, live-client or production-secret qualification.

subsequent_followup.scope: Independent S01 review verifies actual recorded baseline/current bytes, but finds missing-manifest and tracked-dotfile enforcement gaps in the historical lab overlay. S01 owns the mandatory correction before its combined integration/adoption; no original valid source/test result is retroactively represented as an adversarial-control pass.
